* Flashback from nine years prior:
** {{adv|Black}} manages to convince [[Bianca's father]] to let him study Pokémon so that he and {{adv|Cheren}} will be allowed to play with {{adv|Bianca}}.
** Black learns about the Pokémon League and tries to find a way to get a Pokédex.
** Bianca decides to help Black capture a Pokémon, only to disturb a then-wild {{p|Rufflet|Brav}}.
** A then-wild Musha is attracted to Black's dreams and eats them for the first time.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS503|Tooth and Claw]]''
|
* Flashback:
** Thanks to the wild {{p|Munna}}'s help, {{adv|Black}} saves {{adv|Bianca}} from the wild {{p|Rufflet}}.
** {{adv|Black}} decides to capture the wild Rufflet and name it [[Brav]].
** With Munna's help, Black captures the wild Rufflet.
** The wild Munna joins Black's team and is named [[Musha]].
* Black starts his challenge of the [[Icirrus Gym]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS504|The Cold Hard Truth]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}} continues his challenge of the Icirrus Gym.
* {{adv|N}} attempts to convince {{p|Zekrom}} to join his cause.
* [[Drayden]] reveals to the press that the Pokémon League's date has been pushed up from three months to one week.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS505|A Cold Reception]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}} continues his challenge of the Icirrus Gym.
* [[Costa]] evolves into a {{p|Carracosta}} and wins the battle for Black.
* Black obtains the Light Stone.
* Black attempts to summon {{p|Reshiram}}, but fails.
* Black learns that the League's date has been pushed up and becomes worried that he won't be able to compete in the League without eight Badges.
* [[Brycen]] tells Black about the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}.
* [[Iris]] suggests that he try to awaken {{p|Reshiram}}, but Black claims that it's impossible and runs off.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS506|A Week to Go and Old Wounds]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}} decides to capture some Legendary Pokémon in hopes that it will get him access into the League without an eighth Badge.
* Black travels to the [[Mistralton Cave]], where he encounters {{p|Virizion}} and {{p|Terrakion}}.
* Black meets [[Shoko]] of the [[Marvelous Bridge]] {{p|Patrat}} Show and her friend Trish of the {{tc|The Riches|Riches}} family.
* [[Iris]] meets up with [[Cedric Juniper]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS507|A Misunderstanding]]''
|
* {{tc|The Riches|Trish}} attempts to capture the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}.
* A fire breaks out in [[Mistralton Cave]], which {{adv|Black}} and the Swords of Justice put out.
* The Swords of Justice capture {{tc|The Riches|Trish}} and [[Shoko]]'s Pokémon, but Black convinces them to let the Pokémon go.
* Black meets [[Cedric Juniper]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS508|The Lesson Ends Here]]''
|
* [[Alder]] reveals that he intends on giving up his Champion title.
* Alder meets {{adv|N}} and challenges him to a battle.
* N is revealed have tamed {{p|Zekrom}}.
* {{adv|White}} returns to {{adv|Black}} and returns [[Brav]] back to him.
* {{adv|Amanda}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Serperior}}.
* Black, White, and [[Iris]] discover Alder and N's battle.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS509|Will the Truth Come Out?]]''
|
* {{adv|N}} defeats [[Alder]].
* {{p|Reshiram}} awakens from the Light Stone, only to return to its stone form.
* {{adv|White}} tells [[Gigi]] that she is free to choose whatever goal she desires.
* [[Cedric Juniper]] arrives to have {{adv|N}} reveal where Team Plasma's castle is.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS510|A Wretched Reunion]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|White}}, and [[Cedric Juniper]] defeat [[Gigi]] and {{p|Zorua}}.
* [[Professor Juniper]] and [[Fennel]] arrive.
* Cedric Juniper reveals that he and his daughter both had a set of first partner Pokémon.
* Cedric Juniper reveals that {{adv|N}} liberated his set of first partner Pokémon, [[Cedric Juniper|Oshawott]] stayed with him, {{adv|Amanda|Snivy}} went with N, then went to {{adv|White}}, and [[Gigi|Tepig]] ran away.
* No longer liking the taste of Black's dreams, [[Musha]] decides to leave Black.
* Black falls unconscious from Musha's leaving.
* {{adv|N}} escapes and destroys the third Pokédex meant for {{adv|Cheren}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS511|Dream a Little Dream]]''
|
* The {{OBP|Pokémon League|Unova}} begins.
* The [[Elite Four]] question about what to do with [[Team Plasma]].
* [[Cedric Juniper]] deduces that [[Gigi]] was the {{p|Tepig}} that was liberated by {{adv|N}}.
* Without eight Gym Badges, {{adv|Black}} decides to go back home.
* After seeing his Pokémon sad about not entering the League, Black decides to challenge [[Drayden]] for his final Badge.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS512|Hallway Hijinks]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}} challenges [[Drayden]] for his final Gym Badge and entrance into the League.
* [[Caitlin]] uses her powers to relay information between the kidnapped Gym Leaders and {{adv|Black}}.
* Black defeats [[Drayden]], earning him the Legend Badge.
* Black enters the League and makes it to the Best 8.
* [[Iris]], {{adv|Cheren}}, a disguised [[Zinzolin]], a mysterious man in a [[Colress|mask]], [[Leo|a young boy]], a [[Marlon|swimmer]], and a disguised {{adv|Looker}} all join {{adv|Black}} in the Best 8.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS513|Into the Quarterfinals!]]''
|
* [[Brycen]] continues looking for [[N's Castle|Team Plasma's castle]].
* {{adv|Black}} faces [[Looker|Lou Karr]] in the first round of the quarterfinals and wins.
* Lou Karr is revealed to be a disguised {{adv|Looker}} who aims on finding any members of Team Plasma infiltrating the League.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS514|The Tournament Continues]]''
|
* {{adv|Cheren}} faces [[Leo]] in the second round of the quarterfinals and wins.
* [[Colress|Hood Man]] faces [[Marlon]] in the third round and wins.
* [[Iris]] faces [[Zinzolin|Gray]] in the fourth round and wins.
* [[Brycen]] enlists {{adv|White}} in helping him search for [[Team Plasma]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS515|The Shadow Triad]]''
|
* {{p|Cobalion}}, {{p|Terrakion}}, and {{p|Virizion}} head to the [[Pledge Grove]] to meet with their student, {{p|Keldeo}}.
* The [[Shadow Triad]] attempt to capture the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}, but fail.
* {{p|Keldeo}} trains how to use its sword and succeeds.
* [[Team Plasma]] is revealed to be training a {{p|Genesect|secret project}} and are aware that [[Drayden]] pushed the Pokémon League up to lure them out.
* [[Cilan]], [[Cress]], and [[Chili]] attack the Shadow Triad.
* Cobalion decides to track down the Shadow Triad to stop whatever evil goal they have planned.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS516|One Way or Another]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}} and [[Iris]] battle each other in the first round of the semifinals.
* Iris reveals that she is from [[Blackthorn City]], the [[Village of Dragons]].
* Black defeats Iris and advances to the finals.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS517|Something Suspicious]]''
|
* {{adv|Cheren}} defeats [[Colress|Hood Man]] and advances to the finals.
* {{adv|White}} investigates [[Marlon]] and [[Leo]].
* Angered at Cheren's strange behavior, {{adv|Black}} demands to battle his friend in the finals immediately.
* [[N's Castle|Team Plasma's castle]] begins moving from beneath the earth.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS518|True Friends]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}} and {{adv|Cheren}} battle in the finals.
* Cheren reveals that he has been influenced by [[Team Plasma]] and has chosen to follow their ideals so that he can gain strength. He also reveals that he has forsaken his Pokédex.
* {{adv|White}} finds out that [[Zinzolin]] is with [[Team Plasma]] and [[Colress|Hood Man]] is assisting him.
* {{adv|Looker}} captures Zinzolin.
* White attempts to warn Black about Team Plasma, but Hood Man captures her and takes her away.
* Black defeats Cheren.
* [[Musha]] returns to Black, now evolved into a {{p|Musharna}}.
* Angered at Team Plasma's manipulating his friends, Black awakens {{p|Reshiram}} and challenges Team Plasma to come out of hiding.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS519|{{tt|Something Suspicious|Originally titled as Triple Threat}}]]''
|
* [[Cilan]], [[Cress]], and [[Chili]] continue their battle with the [[Shadow Triad]].
* Cilan, Cress, and Chili evolve their {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}}, {{p|Panpour}}, and {{TP|Chili|Pansear}} to gain an advantage.
* The {{adv|Swords of Justice}} arrive and witness the battle.
* {{p|Keldeo}} decides the Gym Leaders are on the side of good and jumps in to stop the Shadow Triad.
* The Shadow Triad attempt to capture Keldeo, but are stopped by {{p|Cobalion}}, {{p|Terrakion}}, and {{p|Virizion}}.
* Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion defeat both the Striaton Gym Leaders and the Shadow Triad.
* As the Swords of Justice leave, the Shadow Triad unleash {{p|Genesect|their secret weapon}} on the quartet.
* Keldeo is almost hit by the weapon's attack, but is protected by its three seniors, who are frozen and sink into the waters below.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS520|Cold Hard Truth]]''
|
* {{adv|Black}} demands that [[Zinzolin]] tell him where [[Colress|Hood Man]] took {{adv|White}}.
* [[Brycen]] digs down to find Team Plasma's castle, but is defeated and captured by [[Ghetsis]].
* Zinzolin summons [[N's Castle]] from beneath the {{OBP|Pokémon League|Unova}}.
* [[Team Plasma]] begins marching out.
* The captured Gym Leaders are hoisted up on crucifix-like objects as a display of Team Plasma's power.
* {{p|Reshiram}} senses {{p|Zekrom}} and leaves Black behind to fight its counterpart.
* The [[Elite Four]] attempt to face Team Plasma, but they are interrupted by Hood Man, who uses {{p|Tornadus}}, {{p|Thundurus}}, and {{p|Landorus}} in an attempt to figure out their Therian Formes.
* Black attempts to rescue the Gym Leaders, but Ghetsis stops his every move.
* Black is assisted by {{tc|Hiker|Andy}}, [[Shoko]], {{tc|The Riches|Trish}}, {{tc|Janitor|Geoff}}, {{tc|Doctor|Logan}}, {{tc|Baker|Chris}}, and {{tc|Biker|Jeremy}}, who decide to rescue the Gym Leaders themselves.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS521|Triple Threat]]''
|
* The [[Seven Sages]] attempt to stop {{adv|Black}}'s friends from rescuing the Gym Leaders.
* Black sends out all of his team except for [[Brav]] to help his friends face the Seven Sages.
* Black and {{p|Reshiram}} face {{adv|N}} and {{p|Zekrom}}.
* [[Cedric Juniper]], [[Leo]], and {{adv|Looker}} assist Black in facing N.
* With Cedric's help, Black figures out the secret to Reshiram and Zekrom's Overdrive states.
* Black uses a powered-up {{m|Fusion Flare}} from Reshiram to deal heavy damage to Zekrom.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS522|Homecoming]]''
|
* {{tc|Hiker|Andy}}'s group frees the Gym Leaders from their bindings.
* The Gym Leaders help battle Team Plasma.
* The Elite Four chase after {{p|Tornadus}}, {{p|Thundurus}}, and {{p|Landorus}}, who have escaped.
* [[Grimsley]] continues battling [[Colress|Hood Man]], but he escapes on a {{p|Genesect|mysterious Pokémon}}.
* The [[Seven Sages]] escape, but [[Ghetsis]] sneaks into where {{adv|N}} and {{adv|Black}} are battling.
* {{adv|White}} awakens in N's room, where she meets [[Anthea and Concordia]].
* Anthea and Concordia reveal that N has released all of the Pokémon he had on his team except for {{p|Zekrom}}.
* Anthea and Concordia tell White about N's past and how he met Ghetsis.
* [[Gigi]] chooses to return to the [[BW Agency]].
* White and Gigi leave to tell Black about what they learned.
* {{p|Zorua}} helps N in battle despite it being released.
* Black and {{p|Reshiram}} defeat N and Zekrom.
* Black reveals that Zorua wants to stay with N.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS523|The Power Of Dreams]]''
|
* The Elite Four track down {{p|Tornadus}}, {{p|Thundurus}}, and {{p|Landorus}} and continue their battle with them.
* Having found peace, {{adv|N}} and {{TP|N|Zorua}} fall asleep.
* [[Ghetsis]] reveals his full name to be Ghetsis Harmonia Gropius and that N is his son.
* Ghetsis attacks {{adv|Black}} in order to keep the public ignorant about N's defeat.
* Using [[Musha]], Black figures out that Ghetsis is using a {{p|Volcarona}} as a secret weapon.
* Black defeats Ghetsis and traps him in a cage of stones.
* [[Colress|Hood Man]] learns that a [[Reveal Glass|mirror]] is the key to turning Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus into their Therian Formes.
* Hood Man goes to assist Ghetsis.
* Black and {{adv|White}} reunite.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS524|A Difficult Parting]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|N}} learns the error of his ways and bids his former enemies farewell, leaving {{TP|N|Zorua}} behind in the process.
* {{p|Reshiram}} begins reverting into the [[Light Stone]] with its counterpart gone.
* The Hood Man helps [[Ghetsis]] escape, and uses his {{p|Beheeyem}} to throw {{adv|Black}} at Reshiram.
* Black and Reshiram become the Light Stone, which flies away when {{adv|White}} tries to grab it.
* As they both escape, Ghetsis thanks Hood Man, who takes off his disguise and reveals himself to be [[Colress]].
* Several Team Plasma Grunts manage to escape being captured and go into hiding.
* One of the {{adv|Whitley|Grunts}} receives a {{p|Foongus}} from [[Anthea and Concordia]] that was liberated by N and a locket containing N's photograph.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS525|The Transfer Student]]''
|
* {{adv|Blake}} breaks up with [[Yancy]].
* {{adv|Cheren}} is revealed to have become a teacher at the [[Aspertia City]] Trainers' School.
* {{adv|Whitley}} transfers into the Trainers' School.
* Blake and Whitley receive Pokédexes.
* {{adv|Looker}} returns to Unova after having failed to find the Seven Sages in other regions.
* Whitley is revealed to be a former member of Team Plasma.
* Blake reveals to Looker that he is a member of the International Police, and is his superior.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS526|Mr. Perfect]]''
|
* {{adv|Cheren}} and {{adv|Bianca}} discuss the earlier Pokédex distribution.
* [[Drayden]] calls Cheren to inform him about {{p|Kyurem}}, the third Pokémon born at the same time as {{p|Reshiram}} and {{p|Zekrom}}.
* Drayden reveals that [[Iris]] has been made Gym Leader, although he plans on returning to his former position later.
* {{adv|Blake}} and {{adv|Looker}} head to the Aspertia City alleyways.
* Blake meets with the {{adv|Magician}} to get specialized Poké Balls.
* A [[Blake's Genesect|flying saucer]] begins attacking the city.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS527|Flying Type]]''
|
* {{adv|Blake}} attacks the flying saucer and reveals it to be a Pokémon named {{p|Genesect}}.
* Blake battles Genesect through the Aspertia alleyways.
* Blake and {{adv|Looker}} learn the creator of Genesect is [[Colress]], who disguised himself as Hood Man two years ago.
* Blake realizes that Colress is controlling Genesect through a machine, which means it is still technically wild.
* Blake prepares to capture Genesect.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS528|Innocent Scientist]]''
|
* {{adv|Blake}} begins his attempt to capture {{p|Genesect}}.
* Blake flashes back to when he first met {{p|Dewott}} at the [[International Police]] headquarters.
* After a struggle, Blake successfully captures Genesect.
* [[Colress]] commends Blake's efforts and reveals that [[Ghetsis]] has given up his leadership of Team Plasma to him.
* Colress escapes before {{adv|Looker}} can arrest him.
* Blake reveals his womanizing personality is a front so that he can find a former member of Team Plasma that is carrying a microchip containing important data on the Pokémon stolen by Team Plasma.
* Blake heads back with Looker and prepares to have Genesect sent back to headquarters.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS529|Pokédex Lecture]]''
|
* {{adv|Blake}} takes {{adv|Whitley}} to the [[Pledge Grove]] to register Pokémon on the Pokédex as a way to get closer to her.
* Whitley accidentally attracts {{p|Keldeo}}, who proceeds to attack the duo.
* Blake manages to get out of the way, but Whitley is knocked unconscious.
* Whitley's Foongus is revealed to have the nickname Foongy.
* Blake takes Whitley back to the school.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS530|Movie Panic]]''
|
* {{adv|Cheren}} takes the class on a trip to [[Pokéstar Studios]].
* {{adv|Blake}} attempts to use the trip as a way to get closer to {{adv|Whitley}}.
* [[Brycen]] is revealed to quit his job as a Gym Leader to return to acting.
* [[Sabrina]] is revealed to have become a famous actress.
* Whitley participates in a movie, only for the Mecha {{p|Tyranitar}} to attack everyone in sight.
* Blake defeats the Mecha Tyranitar, much to Whitley's frustration.
* Brycen suggests that Cheren become the Leader of the Aspertia City Gym.
* {{adv|White}} is revealed to have had a part in Pokéstar Studios's creation.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS531|Unforgettable Memories]]''
|
* [[Hugh]] finds a microchip in the pendant he found.
* Hugh checks the microchip and sees that it contains data on Pokémon that were liberated by [[Team Plasma]].
* Hugh realizes that the {{adv|Whitley|owner}} of the pendant must be a member of Team Plasma and swears to find her.
* [[Colress]] checks up on the new {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt|Grunt}} uniforms.
* Colress talks to [[Ghetsis]] about going to get [[Zinzolin]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS532|Legendary Tornadus]]''
|
* {{adv|Blake}} reveals that [[Giallo]] has been sighted around {{rt|20|Unova}}.
* Blake takes {{adv|Whitley}} to Route 20 and has {{adv|Looker}} watch to see how Whitley reacts to Giallo in order to confirm her relation to [[Team Plasma]].
* Blake and Whitley are attacked by {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus}}, which proceeds to turn into its Therian Forme.
* Blake is revealed to have caught [[Kelden|Keldeo]], nicknaming it "Kelden".
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS533|New Sword Player]]''
|
* {{adv|Blake}} battles against {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus}} with {{TP|Blake|Dewott}} and [[Kelden]].
* Tornadus reveals that its true target is [[Giallo]], who refuses to accept [[Colress]] as [[Team Plasma]]'s new leader.
* Dewott and Kelden freeze Tornadus, forcing the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s to recall it and retreat.
* {{adv|Looker}} arrests Giallo.
* {{adv|Whitley}} is revealed to have fallen asleep, preventing her from being able to recognize Giallo.
* Blake takes Whitley to a concert performed by [[Roxie]] and her band.
* After returning home, Whitley receives the gift she was given to by Blake, which she finds out is a telescope.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS534|Choir Tournament]]''
|
* The [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]] performs in the [[Autumn Choir Tournament]].
* [[Roxie]] participates in the tournament as a judge, having been requested to by {{adv|Blake}}.
* Blake and {{adv|Whitley}}'s team wins the tournament, awarding them to participate in another tournament in [[Castelia City]].
* Roxie has [[Pop Roxie|her father]] take {{adv|Cheren}}'s class to Castelia City.
* Blake reveals to {{adv|Looker}} that [[Bronius]] and [[Ryoku]] were spotted in the [[Castelia Sewers]], and their task is to go and investigate the area.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS535|Angry Boy]]''
|
* [[Hugh]] finds that [[Hugh's sister|his sister]] managed to sneak onto [[Pop Roxie]]'s boat.
* [[Leo]] befriends Hugh's sister and promises to help Hugh keep her out of sight from everyone else.
* After arriving at [[Castelia City]], [[Roxie]] discovers an injured man that was attacked by a group of villains who "liberated" his {{p|Karrablast}}.
* {{adv|Blake}}, {{adv|Whitley}}, [[Hugh]], and Roxie travel to the [[Castelia Sewers]], where they find the culprits were [[Team Plasma]], including [[Bronius]] and [[Ryoku]].
* Hugh attacks the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s, but is swarmed by their Pokémon, forcing the group to scatter.
* {{adv|Looker}} contacts Hugh via his {{TP|Looker|Croagunk}}, but Hugh mistakenly believes that Croagunk is the one who is talking.
* At the [[Cold Storage]], [[Colress]] confronts [[Zinzolin]] about information about {{p|Kyurem}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS536|Cold Storage Battle]]''
|
* [[Zinzolin]] reveals he managed to capture {{p|Kyurem}} two years ago.
* [[Colress]] tells Zinzolin to give him Kyurem, but Zinzolin refuses.
* {{adv|Whitley}} drives off the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s and proceeds to call her mother.
* {{adv|Looker}} attempts to get [[Hugh]] to explain his connection to [[Team Plasma]], but Hugh refuses and runs off.
* {{adv|Blake}} successfully arrests [[Bronius]] and [[Ryoku]], but soon feels a chill in the air.
* Blake has Looker take care of Bronius and Ryoku while he sets off on {{p|Genesect}} to the [[Relic Passage]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS537|Colress Machine]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* [[Zinzolin]] continues his battle against [[Colress]].
* {{adv|Blake}} exits the [[Relic Passage]] and arrives next to the [[Pokémon World Tournament]] construction site.
* Blake is revealed to have captured a {{p|Kabutops}} named Kabutott and a {{p|Gliscor}} named Glisott.
* Blake finds Zinzolin defeated by {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Thundurus}} and {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Landorus}}, who proceed to transform into their Therian Formes.
* Colress reveals he is in possession of the [[Reveal Glass]].
* {{OBP|Mom|Black 2 and White 2|Whitley's mother}} tells {{adv|Whitley}} everything about the black-suited {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s, the [[Colress Machine]], and the microchip in her pendant.
* Whitley decides to find her missing pendant so that she may give it to [[Rood]] or [[Gorm]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS538|Therian Forme III]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* [[Hugh]] meets up with his class and reveals that one of the female students is a member of [[Team Plasma]].
* Hugh decides to leave the school to confront Team Plasma, but {{adv|Whitley}} stops him.
* Finding her behavior suspicious, the class begins to piece together Whitley's true identity, but [[Foongy]] puts them to sleep with the exception of Hugh.
* Hugh realizes that Whitley is a member of Team Plasma.
* {{adv|Blake}} continues battling [[Colress]].
* Blake attempts to arrest [[Zinzolin]], but he is taken away by Colress.
* [[Ghetsis]] reveals himself and the [[Plasma Frigate]].
* Blake attempts to stop Ghetsis, but is attacked by the [[Shadow Triad]].
* Colress takes control of {{p|Kyurem}} and puts it in the Plasma Frigate.
* The Plasma Frigate is activated and takes to the skies.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS539|Frozen World]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|Blake}} sneaks aboard the [[Plasma Frigate]] with [[Kelden]], leaving his other Pokémon behind to battle the [[Shadow Triad]].
* [[Colress]] realizes that Blake has snuck on board, but decides to pretend like he didn't notice.
* [[Hugh]] agrees to return {{adv|Whitley}} her pendant if she takes him to [[Team Plasma]]'s hideout.
* The Plasma Frigate appears above [[Castelia City]].
* Castelia City is frozen over by the Plasma Frigate's {{p|Kyurem}} Cannon.
* Hugh protects Whitley from the cannon's blast, causing him to get knocked out.
* [[Rood]] appears and tells Whitley about the Plasma Frigate.
* The memory card from Whitley's pendant is revealed to not be in Hugh's possession, meaning that it must be back in [[Aspertia City]].
* Rood leaves [[N's Zorua]] to {{a|Illusion|impersonate}} Whitley while they return to Aspertia to get the memory card.
* [[Ghetsis]] orders Colress to capture Rood, but Whitley protects him, causing her to be captured instead.
* Blake sneaks into Whitley's cabin aboard the Plasma Frigate, pretending to have been captured as well.
* Whitley realizes that Blake is a member of the [[International Police]].
* Whitley confesses her Team Plasma membership to Blake, confirming his suspicions about her.
* Blake handcuffs Whitley and confirms his affiliation with the International Police to her.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS540|Flying Ship]]''
| class="roundybr" |

* Whitley agrees to tell Blake about the memory card, but only after they work to free Kyurem from Colress's control.
* Blake and Whitley fight their way through the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s protecting the machine imprisoning Kyurem.
* Blake has Kelden destroy the machine containing Kyurem, only to find that the machine was empty.
* Colress reveals that the machine has already absorbed enough of Kyurem's energy to power the [[Plasma Frigate]] and freeze all of [[Unova]].
* Colress has Kyurem freeze Blake, Whitley, and Kelden, and then has the Grunts toss them into the ocean.
* Colress reveals that Kyurem appeared before [[Zinzolin]] two years earlier because it was responding to the energy released by {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}'s awakening, and that the opposite has also now happened.
* Somewhere, {{adv|N}}, Zekrom, and the [[Light Stone]] fly through the ocean.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|Cheren}} awakens at the [[Marine Tube]] alongside his students and [[Roxie]].
* [[Benga]], another student at the [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]], is revealed to have rescued everyone from [[Castelia City]] alongside [[Marlon]].
* Marlon and Benga ask Cheren and Roxie to join them and [[Iris]] to combat [[Team Plasma]].
* [[Rood]]'s subordinate {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s and a {{a|Illusion|disguised}} {{TP|N|Zorua}} help the class warm up from the cold.
* In [[Aspertia City]], {{adv|Looker}} searches for the missing {{adv|Blake}}, but runs into the {{adv|Magician}}.
* The Magician reveals that Blake has been fired from the [[International Police]] due to him having given the Magician illegal access to the International Police database.
* Blake's Pokémon are defeated by the [[Shadow Triad]] and {{adv|forces of nature}}.
* The Shadow Triad leave to meet up with the [[Plasma Frigate]] at [[Undella Town]].
* The Plasma Frigate continues to freeze over [[Unova]]'s cities.
* [[Fennel]] reveals that the [[Light Stone]] is connected to the {{pkmn|Dream World}}, where {{adv|Black}} must also be.
* {{adv|White}}'s {{p|Solosis|Solly}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Duosion}}.
* White finds the Light Stone at the [[Entralink]], but is then confronted by {{adv|N}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS542|N Returns]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|White}} asks {{adv|N}} why only {{p|Reshiram}} reverted to a [[Dragon Stones|stone]], but he is unable to provide her with an answer.
* White and N take off to confront [[Team Plasma]].
* [[Ghetsis]] takes {{p|Kyurem}} to face N.
* Fearing that he might lose, N has White run away while he fights Ghetsis alone.
* {{adv|Blake}} awakens at the [[Abyssal Ruins]], where he meets with [[Kelden]].
* Kelden takes Blake to the frozen bodies of {{p|Cobalion}}, {{p|Virizion}}, and {{p|Terrakion}}.
* Assuming that since {{m|Techno Blast}} was what froze the three Pokémon to begin with, Blake sends out {{p|Genesect}} to free Kelden's mentors.
* {{adv|Whitley}} reveals herself and tells Blake not to use the {{type|Fire}} Techno Blast, as it is dangerous for Genesect to use.
* Blake reveals that he is incapable of feeling or understanding emotions like "fear" or "pity", and thus sees no problem with putting his Pokémon in serious harm, as it could just be healed later.
* Blake has Genesect free Kelden's mentors from their ice prison.
* Cobalion knocks the incomplete [[Burn Drive]] off of Genesect's back, after which it explodes.
* Blake discovers he has been fired from the [[International Police]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS543|Abyssal Ruins]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|Blake}} {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} a {{p|Shelmet}}.
* Blake has {{adv|Whitley}} catch a {{p|Karrablast}}, which he then has her [[trade]] for his Shelmet, causing them to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Escavalier}} and {{p|Accelgor}}, respectively.
* The [[Abyssal Ruins]] start flooding due to a safety mechanism.
* Blake and Whitley escape from the Abyssal Ruins with [[Kelden]] and the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}.
* [[Hugh]] wakes up in [[Aspertia City]], having been brought back there by [[Rood]].
* Rood agrees to take Hugh to [[Hugh's sister|his sister]]'s {{p|Purrloin}} if he helps stop the [[Plasma Frigate]] and the [[Colress Machine]].
* A group of {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s arrives to eliminate Rood.
* Hugh stays to {{pkmn|battle}} the Grunts while telling Rood that the memory card he's looking for is hidden in his and [[Leo]]'s room.
* Rood takes the memory card.
* Blake is revealed to have the [[DNA Splicers]], which are stolen by [[Ghetsis]].
* {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} uses the DNA Splicers to revert {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}} back into the [[Dark Stone]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS544|Dream World]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|White}} and {{adv|N}} enter the [[Pokémon Dream World]], which is linked to the [[Light Stone]].
* White reunites with {{adv|Black}}.
* {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} successfully absorbs {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}} and changes into {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Kyurem|Black Kyurem}}.
* Kyurem freezes [[Undella Town]].
* Black and White exit the Light Stone.
* Black attempts to fight [[Ghetsis]] and Kyurem, but is defeated.
* N is revealed to have been forced out of the Dream World alongside Black and White.
* Seeing that N poses a threat to the stability of Kyurem's Absofusion, Ghetsis throws him into the sea.
* [[Team Plasma]] escapes thanks to a smokescreen.
* Black and White meet Blake and Whitley for the first time.
* Blake asks for Black's assistance in locating the [[Plasma Frigate]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS545|Deduction Time]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|Black}} figures out that [[Team Plasma]] is headed for the [[Giant Chasm]].
* Since {{adv|N}} disappeared along with Team Plasma's smokescreen, {{adv|Blake}} deduces that he must've been captured.
* The [[Unova]] [[Pokédex holder]]s and the {{adv|Swords of Justice}} head to the Giant Chasm as well.
* [[Leo]] and [[Hugh's sister]] meet [[Elesa]], [[Skyla]], and {{adv|Looker}} at the [[Pokémon World Tournament|PWT]] construction site.
* [[Hugh]] and [[Rood]] escape to White Team Plasma's hideout in [[Driftveil City]] with the memory card required to stop the [[Colress Machine]].
* {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} is revealed to be heading for the Giant Chasm without [[Ghetsis]] or [[Colress]]'s orders.
* Ghetsis sends the [[Shadow Triad]] and the {{adv|forces of nature}} to attack the pursuing Swords of Justice.
* [[Alder]] is revealed to have passed his {{pkmn|Champion}} title on to [[Iris]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS546|Giant Chasm]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* In [[Opelucid City]], [[Clay]] and the {{ci|Striaton}} [[Gym Leader]]s help free people from their frozen homes.
* The [[Unova]] [[Pokédex holder]]s arrive at the [[Giant Chasm]] and meet [[Gorm]] and [[Iris]].
* Iris reveals the over the last two years, she regathered the eight [[Badge]]s, challenged the [[Elite Four]], and defeated both [[Alder]] and {{adv|N}}.
* Learning of Iris's {{pkmn|Champion}} status, {{adv|Black}} swears to defeat her someday.
* [[Colress]] attacks everyone with {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}}, but suddenly loses control of it.
* [[Rood]] appears, informing Colress that the [[Colress Machine]]'s effect has been nullified.
* Kyurem ejects the [[Dark Stone]] from its body and absorbs {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}} instead, transforming into {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Kyurem|White Kyurem}}.
* Realizing that his plans have failed, Colress decides to quit [[Team Plasma]] and escapes.
* {{adv|Blake}} pursues Colress while Black, {{adv|White}}, and Iris try to stop Kyurem from destroying the [[Plasma Frigate]].
* Learning that Blake is no longer a member of the [[International Police]], Colress challenges him with his {{Shiny|Red}} {{p|Genesect}}.
* Sensing that the Red Genesect is the one who froze {{adv|Swords of Justice|its masters}}, [[Kelden]] changes into its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Keldeo|Resolute Forme}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* {{adv|Looker}} returns {{adv|Blake}}'s Pokémon to him.
* {{adv|White}} entrusts [[Gigi]] to {{adv|Whitley}} to help her find {{adv|N}}, before {{m|teleport}}ing her into the [[Plasma Frigate]].
* Whitley encounters [[Hugh]], who apologizes to her and tells he's come to find N as well.
* Whitley and Hugh find N and free him.
* N agrees to return the {{p|Purrloin}} that was stolen from [[Hugh's sister]] after [[Ghetsis]] is defeated.
* In [[Undella Town]], [[Cedric Juniper]] and {{adv|Bianca}} help {{adv|Cheren}} and [[Benga]] to break out of the frozen [[Marine Tube]].
* Cheren's {{p|Snivy}} is revealed to have evolved into {{TP|Cheren|Servine}}.
* [[Kelden]] attacks [[Colress]], but its attack instead hits the [[Reveal Glass]], breaking it.
* With the Reveal Glass broken, the {{adv|forces of nature}} revert to their Incarnate Formes and are defeated by the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}, along with the [[Shadow Triad]].
* The Forces of Nature escape, freed from [[Team Plasma]]'s control.
* Hugh stays to battle the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s who stole Purrloin, while N and Whitley head to face Ghetsis.
* {{adv|N}} and {{adv|Whitley}} find [[Alder]] and {{adv|Looker}}, who have defeated most of [[Ghetsis]]'s Pokémon.
* N confronts Ghetsis in a storage room full of [[Poké Ball]]s containing the Pokémon liberated by [[Team Plasma]] and swears to return all the "liberated" Pokémon to their {{pkmn|Trainer}}s.
* Looker tries to arrest Ghetsis, but he says he'll rather go down with his dream than be taken captive.
* An explosion tears the [[Plasma Frigate]] open, causing all the Poké Balls inside to fall out.
* [[Hugh]] saves a {{p|Snivy}} from the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s he chased.
* N tries to save Ghetsis from falling from the Plasma Frigate, but Ghetsis attacks him and calls him a monster.
* Ghetsis is saved from his fall by {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}.
* {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} separates {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}} from itself and leaves.
* {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|White}}, and [[Iris]] pursue the Plasma Frigate on Reshiram.
* Colress is revealed to be controlling the {{Shiny|Red}} {{p|Genesect}} through an improved [[Colress Machine]] held by his {{p|Beheeyem}}.
* {{adv|Blake}}'s Pokémon destroy the Colress Machine, and Blake defeats Colress with the help of {{p|Victini}}.
* Kyurem briefly returns to freeze Colress solid, allowing Looker to take him into custody.
* The Plasma Frigate collides with [[N's Castle]], setting it on fire.
* The [[Unova first partner Pokémon]] families gather and combine their pledge moves in order to put out the fire.
* Ghetsis is taken into custody.
* Kyurem freezes over the [[Giant Chasm]] in order to rest peacefully.
* [[Hugh's sister]] gets her {{p|Purrloin}} back.
* Reshiram and Zekrom leave Black and N, respectively.

| style="text-align:center" ''|[[PS549|An X-cuse to Come Out and Play]]''
|
* {{adv|Y}} attempts to get {{adv|X}} to leave his house, but to no avail.
* [[Alexa]] and [[Viola]] attempt to interview Y, but are met with anger instead.
* {{adv|Trevor}} picks up three [[first partner Pokémon]] in hopes of getting X out of his house.
* {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}} appear in [[Vaniville Town]] and begin fighting.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS550|X-actly What They Wanted]]''
|
* {{adv|Y}} gets her friends out of [[Vaniville Town]] to escape the destruction from {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}}'s fight.
* {{adv|Trevor}} loses one of the [[first partner Pokémon]] and its Pokédex and {{adv|Shauna}} loses her {{p|Furfrou}}.
* [[Team Flare]] begin their plan to capture {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}} to fuel their ultimate weapon.
* [[Aliana]] and [[Mable]] attack {{adv|X}} to steal his [[Key Stone|ring]].
* Seeing {{adv|X}} and [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|her mother]] in peril allows Li'l Kanga to [[Mega Evolution|transform into]] a stronger form.
* Aliana and [[Mable]] are defeated and forced to retreat.
* With their homes destroyed and things missing, X and his friends leave to find some answers to their current situation.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS551|Inn-teresting Developments]]''
|
* {{adv|Y}} and her friends arrive in [[Aquacorde Town]] to stay the night at an inn.
* The first partner Pokémon that {{adv|Trevor}} lost is revealed to be {{p|Fennekin}}.
* {{adv|Tierno}} suggests that {{p|Chespin}} and {{p|Froakie}} should go to {{adv|X}} and Y.
* The inn's innkeeper reveals herself to be a member of [[Team Flare]] and traps Y, Trevor, Tierno, and {{adv|Shauna}} inside.
* Y breaks free, only to find [[Aliana]] and [[Mable]] attempting to steal [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]].
* X demands that the Team Flare scientists let go of Li'l Kanga.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS552|They Have a Flare for a Li'l Kanga-Napping]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} attempts to have [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] [[Mega Evolution|transform]], but it fails.
* With no choice, X teams up with {{p|Chespin}} and defeats [[Aliana]] and [[Mable]].
* X and Y receive Pokédexes.
* The group escapes and goes to camp out in the forest for the night.
* {{adv|Trevor}} discovers a [[Mega Stone|strange stone]] in Kanga's pouch.
* [[Professor Sycamore]] shows [[Lysandre]] the footage of the [[Vaniville Town]] incident.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS553|Sylveon Enchants]]''
|
* {{adv|Y}} is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} an {{p|Eevee}}, [[nickname]]d Veevee.
* After playing [[Pokémon-Amie|various games]] together with Y, Veevee [[Evolution|evolves]] into {{p|Sylveon}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS554|Kangaskhan...Kangascan't]]''
|
* [[Lysandre]] and [[Professor Sycamore]] review the footage of the Vaniville Town incident that {{adv|Trevor}} sent.
* {{adv|X}} and his friends arrive in [[Santalune City]].
* {{adv|Y}} comes up with a set of rules the make sure that her friends are safe.
* X and Trevor attempt to try and figure out the [[Mega Evolution|transformation]] that [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] can use.
* The group is approached by [[Viola]], who offers to help them.
* When Y accepts Viola's offer, {{adv|Shauna}}  runs off in anger because everyone decides to trust her so easily.
* [[Celosia]] tricks Shauna into being put under mind control.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" ''|[[PS555|The Aegislash Agenda]]''
|
* [[Viola]] challenges {{adv|X}} to a battle and loses.
* {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Y}} go over Viola's photos to find clues.
* Y finds {{adv|Shauna}} , but notices her strange behavior.
* X reveals how he obtained his [[Mega Ring]].
* Under the control of [[Celosia]], Shauna steals [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]]'s [[Kangaskhanite|stone]].
* After being caught, Shauna attacks Y, only for Viola to push her out of the way and take the attack.
* The strain of the mind control causes Shauna to faint.
* With the stone in hand, Celosia escapes with X pursuing her.
* X is helped by a [[Korrina|girl]] and her {{p|Lucario}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS556|Lucky Lucario Was Here]]''
|
* [[Korrina]] and her [[Mega Evolution|Mega]] {{p|Lucario}} come to help {{adv|X}} and his friends.
* {{adv|Trevor}} learns the transformation [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] went through is called Mega Evolution.
* [[Viola]] awakens and reveals that she called Korrina to help after seeing the [[Key Stone]] on X's [[Mega Ring]].
* With Viola's help, Li'l Kanga retrieves the [[Kangaskhanite]], allowing her to Mega Evolve.
* X learns that the [[Gurkinn|man]] who gave him his Mega Ring is Korrina's grandfather.
* Mega Lucario and Li'l Kanga defeat [[Celosia]], forcing her to retreat.
* Back at the Gym, {{adv|Shauna}} awakens and apologizes for not following {{adv|Y}}'s orders.
* Korrina gives {{adv|Tierno}} a pair of [[Roller Skates]].
* When X states he doesn't care about being a Mega Evolution Successor, Korrina decides to not tell him anything about Mega Evolution and leaves.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS558|What Does Charmander Do When It Dozes]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} and his friends arrive at {{rt|4|Kalos}}.
* {{adv|Trevor}} has X test [[Mega Evolution]] on {{p|Chespin}}, but it fails.
* Chespin and {{p|Froakie}} notice a {{p|Charmander}} sleeping in the flowerbeds and recognize it, confirming that Charmander belongs to [[Professor Sycamore]].
* A disguised [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] mistake X's group as thieves stealing Professor Sycamore's missing Charmander and takes it from them.
* {{adv|Tierno}} uses his [[Roller Skates]] to retrieve Charmander and clears up the confusion.
* X's group arrives at [[Lumiose City]], where they meet Professor Sycamore in person.
* Professor Sycamore challenges X to a battle after he notices that X hasn't picked Chespin as his Pokémon yet.
* Trevor and the others meet [[Lysandre]] to get the [[Holo Caster]] fixed, but Trevor gets scared after seeing Lysandre's silhouette in one of the photos [[Viola]] took.
* [[Xerosic]] finds {{p|Xerneas}}, who has reverted to the form of a tree.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS559|Chespin Sows the Seeds of Change]]''
|
* [[Lysandre]] begins fixing {{adv|Trevor}}'s [[Holo Caster]].
* Trevor tries to ask Lysandre about the photo, but is too scared to speak.
* When Lysandre notices, he sends his Pokémon out to coerce Trevor into giving him the photo.
* {{adv|X}} battles [[Professor Sycamore]] with {{p|Chespin}}, but shows no interest.
* Chespin's refusal to back down impresses X enough to battle with it, but they end up losing to {{p|Charmander}}.
* X decides to keep Chespin and names it Marisso.
* X tells Professor Sycamore to give him Charmander as well.
* X senses his friends are in trouble and heads off to Lysandre Café.
* {{adv|Y}} and her friends are protected by [[Diantha]], who tells Lysandre to back off of his threats.
* Lysandre gets a call from [[Xerosic]] about {{p|Xerneas}} and leaves to do other business.
* Y recognizes Diantha as a famous movie star.
* After Diantha leaves, Trevor falls unconscious from stress.
* Lysandre tells his {{p|Gyarados}} that it will also be able to Mega Evolve as he looks at its Mega Stone.
* Y's group meets up with X.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS562|Pangoro Poses a Problem]]''
|
* [[Alexa]] finishes her report of the [[Vaniville Town]] incident.
* Alexa learns from [[Viola]] what happened in [[Santalune City]].
* Alexa heads off to Prism Tower to have an interview with [[Professor Sycamore]].
* X reveals he decided to keep {{p|Chespin|Marisso}} and nicknamed {{p|Charmander}} Salamè.
* Upon arriving, Alexa finds that the Lumiose Press editor-in-chief has already done the interview in her place.
* Sensing that something is wrong, {{adv|X}} heads into Prism Tower and finds Alexa being attacked by the editor-in-chief.
* X rescues Alexa, but the editor-in-chief captures {{p|Helioptile|Heli}} and holds it hostage.
* {{adv|Y}} takes Alexa to safety and promises that X will rescue Heli.
* Alexa realizes that some force must be controlling the media to ensure the truth about Vaniville Town does not become public knowledge.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS563|Charging After Electrike]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} beats the Lumiose Press editor-in-chief and rescues Heli.
* [[Alexa]] gives the group a document that may help their adventure.
* Alexa leaves to meet with [[Viola]].
* {{adv|Trevor}} awakens.
* An {{p|Electrike}} from the Prism Tower begins following the group.
* [[Bonnie]] discovers the editor-in-chief unconscious, and finds that one of the Pokémon powering the Gym has gone missing.
* [[Grant]] and Clemont notice {{kal|Grace}} being captured by Team Flare.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS565|Fast-Thinking Froakie]]''
|
* {{adv|Y}} decided to add {{p|Froakie}} to her team and named it Croaky.
* An {{p|Electrike}} attacks Y and steals her clothes.
* Croaky defeats the Electrike and retrieves Y's clothes.
* Team Flare locks {{kal|Grace}} into a cell.
* [[Clemont]] introduces himself to the group and reveals the Electrike was from his Gym.
* The Electrike evolves into a {{p|Manectric}}.
* {{adv|X}} realizes that Manectric was leading them to something that it wanted on top of a tree.
* The item is revealed to be another Mega Stone, which a Team Flare Grunt is also aiming for.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS566|Overthrowing a Tyrunt]]''
|
* [[Clemont]] helps search for the Mega Stone in the tree, only to find the {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}} watching them.
* The Grunt is exposed, but has his {{p|Tyrunt}} chew the tree and knock it down to collapse onto Clemont.
* Clemont is crushed by the tree and the Mega Stone is taken.
* {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Trevor}} chase after the Grunt while {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}}  combat the Grunt's other Pokémon.
* Clemont tells Y that her mother has been captured by Team Flare.
* X and Trevor arrive at the [[Parfum Palace]], where the Grunt also steals Kanga's Kangaskhanite.
* X decides to keep {{p|Manectric}} and names it Élec.
* [[Cassius]] overhears the commotion and decides to intervene.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS567|Morphing Manectric]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} continues his battle against the {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}.
* {{adv|Trevor}} helps X battle the Grunt.
* [[Clemont]] tells {{adv|Y}} more about {{kal|Grace|her mother}}'s kidnapping.
* [[Cassius]] arrives and defeats the Grunt's {{p|Espurr}}.
* Clemont is sent flying by Psychic energy after he opens the Grunt's Espurr's ears to see the organs under them.
* At the cost of its flower, Trevor's {{p|Flabébé}} retrieves [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] and Élec's Mega Stones and gives them back.
* X [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolves]] Élec into Mega Manectric, allowing it to defeat the Grunt.
* The Grunt escapes, but drops a document containing a list of various Pokémon and the Mega Stones required to Mega Evolve them.
* X and Trevor return to their friends, only to find Y depressed from the news about her mother.
* Cassius introduces himself and his friends to X's group.
* Cassius introduces [[Emma]], who has adopted one of the Grunt's Espurr.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" ''|[[PS568|Connecting with Gardevoir]]''
|

|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS569|Glittering Diancie]]''
|

|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS570|Dancing Vivillon]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} and his friends travel with [[Cassius]] and his gang to avoid their enemies.
* [[Emma]] nicknames her new {{p|Espurr}} Mimi.
* {{adv|Y}} refuses to move due to the shock of what happened to {{kal|Grace|her mother}}.
* [[Team Flare]] is revealed to have captured [[Clemont]].
* [[Malva]] returns to active duty as a member of Team Flare and takes back the {{p|Pyroar}} she lent to [[Aliana]].
* Malva finds the missing {{p|Fennekin}}'s Poké Ball and takes it for herself.
* The third Pokédex is accidentally smashed under Malva's heel.
* Cassius decides to travel by air via the Battle Chateau's helicopter.
* A group of {{tc|Sky Trainer}}s surround the helicopter.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS571|Burning Fletchinder]]''
|
* The {{tc|Sky Trainer}}s attack the helicopter.
* {{adv|Y}} goes to battle the Sky Trainers, only to find they are her classmates from the [[Vaniville Town]] Sky Trainer academy.
* [[Yvette]], the leader of the Sky Trainers, taunts Y about her issues with her mother.
* Angered by Yvette's statements, Y manages to get over the events of what happened to her mother.
* {{p|Fletchling|Fletchy}} evolves into a {{p|Fletchinder}} and defeats Yvette's {{p|Vivillon}}.
* {{adv|X}} defeats the {{p|Aegislash}} that [[Malva]] used to control the Sky Trainers.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS572|Shooting Frogadier]]''
|
* The damage done to the helicopter causes it to break down.
* A propellor breaks off of the helicopter and hits {{adv|Y}} in the head, knocking her to the ground.
* Y lands safely due to {{p|Froakie|Croaky}}'s Frubbles.
* Y overhears [[Celosia]] and [[Malva]] talking about their plans to move {{p|Xerneas}} to Team Flare's base.
* Malva returns Celosia's {{p|Aegislash}}.
* Sensing Y's presence, Celosia attacks with her {{p|Honedge}} and manages to cut off a chunk of Y's hair.
* Croaky evolves into a {{p|Frogadier}} to save Y and escape Celosia.
* [[Cassius]] manages to land the helicopter, but is yelled at by [[Grant]] for the damages done to [[Cyllage City]]'s cycling track.
* {{adv|X}} and his friends leave Cassius behind to go find Y.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS573|Gathering Klefki]]''
|
* [[Clemont]] awakens at the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]].
* [[Xerosic]] holds Clemont's {{p|Heliolisk}} hostage to force him to build a machine for Team Flare.
* [[Emma|Essentia]] returns to have her Expansion Suit upgraded.
* {{kal|Grace}} manages to get the captured [[Vaniville Town]] residents freed with the help of a wild {{p|Klefki}}.

* Celosia and Malva part ways to begin their plans.
* Y reunites with X and the others.
* Grace frees all the Vaniville residents, only for Celosia to arrive as they are leaving.
* Celosia possesses the Vaniville residents with her {{p|Aegislash}} and begins the operation to move Xerneas.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS574|Tying Trevenant]]''
|
* {{adv|Y}} and the others group and discuss how to deal with [[Team Flare]]'s plan.
* {{adv|X}} suggests watching Team Flare, following them to their base, and then attacking them with his [[Mega Evolution|Mega-Evolved]] Pokémon.
* [[Celosia]] begins the operation to move {{p|Xerneas}}.
* Celosia's {{p|Honedge}} presents Celosia a piece of Y's hair that it chopped off earlier.
* When {{kal|Grace}} notices the hair, she briefly regains slight control of herself and tries to take the hair only to be knocked to the ground.
* When Y sees this, she immediately attacks Celosia, only to fall due to her damaged Sky Suit.
* X leaps in to help Y, but his attempts to simultaneously Mega Evolve [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] and {{p|Manectric|Élec}} fail and he is captured by [[Emma|Essentia]]'s {{p|Trevenant}}.

* Celosia attempts to finish X off, but a {{p|Gengar}} stops her {{p|Aegislash}} from killing him.
* [[Korrina]], [[Diantha]], and [[Gurkinn]] arrive to save X and his friends.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS575|Changing Gengar]]''
|
* The battle against [[Team Flare]] continues.
* [[Gurkinn]] frees {{adv|X}} from his bindings and teaches him about [[Mega Evolution]].
* X battles [[Emma|Essentia]] while [[Korrina]] goes after [[Celosia]].
* [[Malva]] reveals herself and seals [[Diantha]] inside a {{m|Magic Room}}.
* Gurkinn gives X his {{p|Gengar}}, which is given the nickname Garma.
* X Mega Evolves Garma into Mega Gengar and defeats Essentia's {{p|Trevenant}}.
* Korrina arrives at Celosia's location and begins attacking her.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS576|Surrounding Braixen]]''
|
* [[Korrina]] begins attacking [[Celosia]].
* [[Emma|Essentia]] attempts to fool {{adv|X}}'s group with her suit's camouflage abilities, but the wild {{p|Klefki}} stops her.
* [[Xerosic]] has Essentia retreat.
* [[Diantha]] and [[Malva]] continue their battle.
* The {{m|Magic Room}} sinks into the ground, despite {{adv|Y}} and {{adv|Shauna}} 's efforts to stop it.
* Korrina defeats Celosia, but her {{TP|Korrina|Lucario}} is knocked out as well.
* As she celebrates her victory, Celosia's {{p|Honedge}} sneaks behind Korrina and attacks.

|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS577|Quilladin Stands]]''
|

* [[Valerie]], [[Olympia]], and [[Grant]] come to visit Korrina, but soon leave to meet with [[Wulfric]] and [[Ramos]].
* {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} {{pkmn|training|train}} with [[Gurkinn]].
* {{adv|X}}, blaming himself for what happened to Korrina, holes himself at the base of a large tree.
* {{p|Chespin|Marisso}} and {{p|Charmander|Salamè}} evolve into {{p|Quilladin}} and {{p|Charmeleon}}, respectively.
* [[Xerosic]] presents [[Lysandre]] with a Mega Ring fitted with Korrina's [[Key Stone]] and the Lysandre Machine created by [[Clemont]].
* Having no more use for him, Xerosic throws Clemont down a garbage incineration chute.
* X receives a telepathic message from {{p|Xerneas}} assuring him to not give up and aim to fix his mistake.
* {{p|Klefki}} presents X with Clemont's glasses, which show an image of [[Geosenge Town]].
* X realizes that Clemont is in Team Flare's Secret HQ, and sets off to Geosenge Town to stop Team Flare.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS578|Gyarados Changes]]''
|

* X is approached by [[Emma]], who reveals she followed him and offers to help infiltrate the building.
* [[Bryony]] sends [[Aliana]] and [[Mable]] away and knocks [[Celosia]] unconscious due to the effect of using her {{p|Aegislash}} too much.
* Bryony opens the HQ's doors for X and Emma.
* X gets separated from Emma after stepping on a [[warp panel]], sending him into the [[ultimate weapon]]'s control room with [[Lysandre]].
* Lysandre reveals his Mega Ring with the [[Key Stone]] fitted from [[Korrina]]'s Mega Glove and uses it to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] his {{p|Gyarados}}.
* {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} finish their training with [[Gurkinn]].
* Gurkinn begins wondering if he should give Y his Key Stone.
* {{adv|Trevor}} informs everyone that X left.
* Emma continues exploring the building, and ends up in front of the cell of a [[AZ|giant man]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS579|Pyroar Breathes]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} continues his battle with [[Lysandre]].
* During the battle, {{p|Xerneas}} turns back into its normal form.
* {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, {{adv|Shauna}}, and the Kalos Gym Leaders set off to [[Geosenge Town]].
* Y adds {{p|Rhyhorn}} to her team and names it Rhyrhy.
* Despite Xerneas taking back most of its energy, Lysandre decides to continue activating the [[ultimate weapon]].
* Y and the others arrive in Geosenge Town as the ultimate weapon is being unearthed.
* Y and the Gym Leaders use their bodies to try and keep the ultimate weapon's petals from blooming.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS580|Flabébé Blooms]]''
|
* {{adv|Y}} and the Gym Leaders continue to try and keep the [[ultimate weapon]] from blooming.
* [[Bryony]] attacks the Gym Leaders to stop them from interfering with the ultimate weapon.
* [[Olympia]] tells {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} to head to the ultimate weapon's control room.
* As they travel, Trevor's group meets with [[Clemont]] again.
* Trevor's group passes by the cell of [[AZ]], who was befriended by [[Emma]].
* AZ tells the group the story about how he fired the ultimate weapon after using it to revive his deceased {{p|Floette}}.
* After freeing AZ, Trevor's group arrives at the control room, where they find {{adv|X}} defeated.
* Trevor confronts [[Lysandre]] and attempts to remove the ultimate weapon's control room.
* Tierno and Shauna assist Trevor, but the ultimate weapon fires on Kalos despite them successfully removing the key.
* {{p|Xerneas}} tells AZ that despite the ultimate weapon firing, there is a human that it wishes to join forces with.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS581|Rhyhorn Charges]]''
|
* [[AZ]] has {{p|Xerneas}} take everyone back to the surface while he is captured by [[Xerosic]].
* {{adv|Y}} reveals that she and the Gym Leaders survived the blast due to the barriers created by [[Valerie]] and [[Olympia]]'s Pokémon.
* Xerosic informs [[Lysandre]] that despite the [[ultimate weapon]] firing, only buildings were damaged and no lives were taken in the blast.
* After Xerneas lands on the surface, it begins searching for a human to capture it.
* [[Bryony]] and a group of {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s attempt to capture Xerneas.
* Y decides to take Xerneas for herself and names it Xerxer.
* Y and Xerxer easily defeat Bryony and the Grunts.
* Y attempts to destroy the ultimate weapon, only to be stopped by the arrival of [[Malva]], who has captured {{p|Yveltal}}.
* Malva reveals that Yveltal went dormant in its cocoon form buried in the ground under Xerneas's tree form.
* Malva attacks Y, but Xerosic tells her to stop as Lysandre stated that Xerneas and Yveltal are equal in strength, which means that battling will only lead to an endless fight between the two.
* Xerxer decides that retreating is the best option and flies off with everyone on its back.
* {{adv|Blue}} watches the incident unfold from afar and wonders if "{{p|Zygarde|Z}}" is the key to ending the battle between Xerneas and Yveltal.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS582|Pinsir Glares]]''
|
* {{adv|Blue}} helps [[Diantha]] out from underground and is revealed to have taken back {{TP|Blue|Rhyperior}}.
* Blue tells Diantha that he is searching for {{p|Zygarde}}, also known as "Z", in order to stop the battle between {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}}.
* {{adv|X}} and his friends rest at the [[Lost Hotel]], where they have a meal cooked by [[Siebold]].
* [[Ramos]] reveals that Team Flare blamed the destruction caused by the [[ultimate weapon]] on the Vaniville group and the Gym Leaders.
* The Kalos Gym Leaders help rebuild the damaged done by the ultimate weapon.
* {{adv|Y}} has {{adv|Shauna}} cut her hair shorter and receives a [[Mega Ring]] from [[Gurkinn]].
* Y takes X out to capture a Pokémon capable of [[Mega Evolution]].
* Y flashes back to the day she first met X.
* X decides that Y should capture an {{p|Absol}} while he decides to get a {{p|Pinsir}}.
* As they search, a wild Pinsir watches X and Y from afar.
* While traveling with Blue, Diantha wonders about the true identity of [[Emma|Essentia]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS583|Scizor Defends]]''
|
* [[Team Flare]] is revealed to have gone into hiding at [[Pokémon Village]].
* {{adv|Y}} captures an {{p|Absol}}.
* The group comes across an unconscious {{p|Scyther}} that is guarded by a wild {{p|Pinsir}}.
* X attempts to capture the Pinsir, but fails due to a lack of skill in throwing [[Poké Ball]]s.
* X's group meets {{adv|Blue}} and learns that [[Diantha]] is safe.
* Blue assists X in capturing the wild Pinsir and reveals the Scyther is unconscious due to its life energy being drained.
* After battling Blue together, X convinces Pinsir to join his team until Scyther recovers from its condition.
* {{adv|Trevor}} receives a call from [[Professor Sycamore]], who asks everyone to meet him in [[Anistar City]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS584|Hawlucha Attacks]]''
|
* As [[Professor Sycamore]] waits, {{adv|Zygarde}} appears behind him.
* {{adv|Blue}} and [[Diantha]] meet with [[Gurkinn]] at the [[Lost Hotel]].
* Blue is revealed to be a [[Mega Evolution]] Successor.
* {{adv|X}} and his friends arrive in [[Anistar City]], only to find Professor Sycamore under attack.
* X's {{p|Pinsir}} is revealed to be named Rute while Y's {{p|Absol}} is named Solsol.
* Together, X and Y rescue Professor Sycamore.
* Sycamore reveals that due to the [[ultimate weapon]] firing on Kalos, X and Y are now able to search for [[Mega Stone]]s between 8 PM and 9 PM.
* X and Y give their [[Mega Ring]]s to {{adv|Tierno}} and {{adv|Shauna}} so that they may find the Mega Stones for Rute and Solsol.
* [[Emma|Essentia]] watches the event from afar, but is spotted by Y.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS585|Pinsir Changes]]''
|
* {{adv|Tierno}} and {{adv|Shauna}} search for the [[Mega Stone]]s for {{p|Pinsir|Rute}} and {{p|Absol|Solsol}}.
* {{adv|Y}} battles [[Emma|Essentia]] on the rooftops of [[Anistar City]].
* Essentia uses her suit's Poké Ball Jack function to try and take control over [[Xerxer]].
* Essentia, disguising herself as a Nurse, knocks Y out and steals Xerxer.
* Tierno and Shauna come across a large pile of Pokémon drained of their life energy.
* Essentia attempts to trick {{adv|X}} while disguised as Y, but her plan is easily seen through.
* Tierno and Shauna return with a now-conscious Y.
* Tierno and Shauna hand X and Y their [[Mega Ring]]s back and give them the Mega Stones they found.
* X and Y [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] Rute and Solsol into Mega Pinsir and Mega Absol, respectively.
* Essentia prepares to use Xerxer to battle X and Y.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS586|Zygarde Appears]]''
|
* [[Xerosic]] discovers that the stones on {{rt|10|Kalos}} are primitive Absorbers, which will allow the [[ultimate weapon]] to be powered again.
* Xerosic reveals he is aware of {{adv|Zygarde}}'s existence, having been told that Team Flare was under its surveillance after [[AZ]] escaped from being captured.
* Xerosic checks on [[Emma|Essentia]]'s vitals, only to find that she is in battle in [[Anistar City]].
* {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Y}} battle against Essentia, who struggles to fully control [[Xerxer]] due to its Legendary status.
* The battle is interrupted by the arrival of Zygarde, forcing Essentia to attempt to capture it.
* {{adv|Blue}} and [[Diantha]] arrive, but are too late to stop Essentia from taking Zygarde and escaping.
* The damage done to Essentia's suit prevents Xerosic from communicating with or controlling her anymore.
* [[Professor Sycamore]] receives a call from [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]], who inform him that Team Flare has gone into hiding at [[Pokémon Village]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS587|Malamar Traps]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} and his friends stay the night at {{rt|18|Kalos}} before heading to [[Pokémon Village]] to confront [[Team Flare]].
* [[Diantha]] introduces X to [[Wikstrom]] and [[Drasna]], who are also assisting the heroes.
* [[Xerosic]] reports the recent events to [[Lysandre]], who orders that he stop the [[Emma|Expansion Suit]] project.
* The next day, X and his friends set off to the Pokémon Village alongside [[Diantha]] and {{adv|Blue}}.
* {{adv|Y}} reveals that [[Xerxer]] has reverted to its tree form while [[Salamè]] refuses to leave its {{i|Poké Ball}}.
* As they travel, [[Croaky]] senses something and evolves into a {{p|Greninja}}.
* Croaky attempts to warn the group of an attacker, but everyone falls asleep before fully understanding its intentions.
* The culprit reveals himself to be Xerosic, who used his {{p|Malamar}}'s {{m|Hypnosis}} to put everyone to sleep.
* X reveals that he didn't fall asleep and has Croaky defeat Malamar.
* X interrogates Xerosic and asks why he didn't just ambush them at the Pokémon Village.
* At the Pokémon Village, multiple Team Flare members report being attacked by Wikstrom, Drasna, and [[Siebold]].
* Inside {{kal|Unknown Dungeon|a cave}} at the village, {{adv|Mewtwo}} lies in wait.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS588|Chesnaught Protects]]''
|
* {{adv|X}} continues to interrogate [[Xerosic]], who refuses to give a straight answer.
* Xerosic reveals how he met [[Lysandre]].
* [[Croaky]] is defeated by {{p|Malamar}}, leaving X with only [[Salamè]], who still refuses to leave his Poké Ball.
* Xerosic attempts to attack Salamè's Poké Ball, but is stopped by [[Marisso]], who evolves into a {{p|Chesnaught}} to protect Salamè.
* Seeing his friend protect him gives Salamè the courage to come out and fight.
* X reveals the reason Salamè refused to come out was because he was scared that he couldn't handle [[Mega Evolution]].
* Despite Xerosic's confidence that {{p|Charizard}} doesn't have a Mega Evolution, Salamè blows on his tail to reveal a Charizardite X.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS589|Charizard Transforms]]''
|
* {{adv|Blue}} wakes up and reveals that he is a [[Mega Evolution]] Successor with a [[Key Stone]].
* [[Salamè]] evolves into a {{p|Charizard}}.
* {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} go on ahead to the [[Pokémon Village]] while {{adv|X}} and Blue fight [[Xerosic]].
* With their Key Stones, X and Blue Mega Evolve Salamè and {{TP|Blue|Charizard}} into Mega Charizard X and Y, respectively.
* The remaining [[Team Flare]] Scientists pick one member of Y's group to fight alone.
* [[Aliana]] chooses to battle Y, [[Mable]] chooses Tierno, [[Celosia]] chooses Shauna, and [[Bryony]] chooses Trevor.
* X and Blue defeat Xerosic and leave to go help their friends.
* [[Malva]]'s {{p|Yveltal}} appears and attacks Blue, but it is blocked by Y and [[Xerxer]].
* Xerxer decides to stay behind and fight Yveltal while Y, X, Blue, and Trevor go on ahead.
* Y and Trevor decide to stay behind and help Tierno and Shauna while X and Blue head to the village.
* Malva's {{p|Braixen}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{tp|Malva|Delphox}}.
* On {{Rt|10|Kalos}}, {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s tie captured Pokémon to the ancient Absorbers, and one of the Pokémon turns out to be Shauna's {{p|Furfrou}}, who recognizes Delphox and calls out to it.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS590|Yveltal Steals]]''
|
* [[Xerxer]] continues its battle against {{p|Yveltal}}.
* {{adv|Y}} and {{adv|Trevor}} decide to stay behind and help {{adv|Tierno}} and {{adv|Shauna}} while {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Blue}} head to the [[Pokémon Village]].
* [[Diantha]] is revealed to have awakened, but is intercepted by [[Malva]].
* X and Blue arrive at the village, but are attacked by {{adv|Mewtwo}}.
* [[Lysandre]] appears and reveals that Mewtwo is the protector of the Pokémon Village.
* Mewtwo [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolves]] into Mega Mewtwo Y.
* Blue notices another person in the distance who was responsible for Mega Evolving Mewtwo.
* Lysandre uses a device to summon {{adv|Zygarde}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS591|Mewtwo Angered]]''
|
* [[Lysandre]]'s Pokémon continue to battle {{adv|Mewtwo}}.
* Lysandre reveals that he has complete control over [[Emma|Essentia]].
* The person who [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] Mewtwo is revealed to be {{adv|Blaine}}.
* Lysandre has Essentia command {{adv|Zygarde}} to attack everyone with {{m|Land's Wrath}}.
* [[Diantha]] blocks [[Malva]]'s attack, but finds that Malva stole her [[Key Stone|Mega Charm]].
* {{adv|Y}} and {{adv|Trevor}} are attacked by [[Aliana]] and [[Bryony]].
* Trevor's {{p|Flabébé}} evolves into a {{p|Floette}}.
* Trevor decides to stay behind and fight while Y goes to help {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Blue}}.
* Blaine reveals that Mewtwo has two Mega-Evolved forms and their bond allows them to utilize Mega Evolution more than once per battle.
* Mewtwo Mega Evolves into Mega Mewtwo X in order to fight Zygarde.
* X attacks Essentia in order to sever Lysandre's control over Zygarde, only to find that Emma is the one in the suit.
* Y finds Diantha and Malva battling in the air and knocks the Mega Charm out of Malva's hand.
* Blue finds the Mega Charm and realizes that it may be the key to victory.
* X tries to help Emma out of the suit, but she refuses.
* Y attempts to help Diantha, but is rejected.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS592|Zygarde Agitated]]''
|
* [[Diantha]] and [[Malva]] continue their battle.
* {{adv|Trevor}} is unable to defeat [[Bryony]], but is assisted by [[Croaky]], who was left behind to help.
* {{adv|Blaine}} and {{adv|Mewtwo}} are defeated.
* [[Emma]] reveals she is helping [[Team Flare]] to get money to help [[Cassius]].
* Cassius arrives and destroys the device keeping Emma under [[Lysandre]]'s control.
* Emma attempts to have {{adv|Zygarde}} attack Lysandre, but is attacked and has Zygarde's {{i|Poké Ball}} stolen.
* {{adv|Y}} has {{p|Absol|Solsol}} take back the [[Key Stone]] that was stolen from [[Korrina]].
* Lysandre announces to all of [[Kalos]] that he plans on activating the [[ultimate weapon]] to wipe the slate clean.
* Blue, Emma, and Cassius are defeated by Zygarde's attack.
* X takes the Key Stones from Blue, Korrina, Diantha, and Y in order to activate simultaneous five-times Mega Evolution for all his capable Pokémon.
* X's Mega-Evolved team set out to battle Zygarde.
* On {{rt|10|Kalos}}, the process of draining the life energy is interrupted by the arrival of [[Alexa]], [[Viola]], [[Clemont]], [[Bonnie]], and [[Yvette]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PS593|Xerneas Gives]]''
|
* [[Clemont]]'s team work together to free the captured Pokémon, but are attacked by {{TP|Malva|Delphox}}.
* [[Chalmers]]'s attempts to call for backup, only to find the Gym Leaders have already defeated the other members of Team Flare.
* {{adv|Tierno}}, {{adv|Shauna}}, and {{adv|Trevor}} defeat the four Team Flare Scientists.
* Trevor's group goes to help the others, only to find [[Xerxer]] and {{p|Yveltal}} returning to their dormant forms.
* Xerxer reveals that with it and Yveltal gone, {{adv|Zygarde}} would have no reason to remain there.
* {{adv|X}}'s team continues attacking Zygarde, which begins splitting into pieces.
* After a combined attack, Zygarde is fully separated after Xerxer and Yveltal fully revert.
* With nothing to stand on, [[Lysandre]] falls to the rubble below.
* [[Malva]] attempts to save Lysandre, but both end up falling onto the ground and are defeated.
* With Team Flare defeated, X and his friends head back to [[Lumiose City]] and say farewell to their allies.
* Despite their hard work, the townspeople treat X and his friends as if they were dirty street urchins. [[AZ]] then approaches the group and asks how they plan on living in Kalos with the knowledge they had just learned.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS594|Floette Returns]]''
| class="roundybr" |
* [[AZ]] reveals that he was the one who made the [[ultimate weapon]] and retrieved the key from the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]].
* AZ states that Team Flare's goals weren't wrong and goes to reactivate the ultimate weapon.
* {{adv|X}} and his friend battle AZ to stop him, which ends with the key being destroyed.
* AZ reveals the whole ordeal was an act to convince X and his friends to not take the same path [[Lysandre]] did.
* With his mind at ease, AZ thanks the kids, but is shocked to see the return of his {{p|Floette}}.
* AZ and Floette go their separate ways from X's group.
* [[Professor Sycamore]], the Kalos Gym Leaders, [[Alexa]], [[Bonnie]], and [[Yvette]] arrive to greet X and his friends.
* [[Clemont]] returns {{p|Furfrou|Tri-P}} to {{adv|Shauna}} and gives {{adv|Trevor}} the {{TP|Malva|Delphox}} he fought at {{rt|10|Kalos}}.
* Professor Sycamore proposes to have a parade to celebrate the victory of the Vaniville children, but they decline.
* X and his friends head back to [[Vaniville Town]], where {{adv|Y}} reunites with {{kal|Grace}}.
* {{adv|Blue}} and {{adv|Blaine}} reveal they saw a strange creature from where {{adv|Zygarde}} once stood.
* Professor Sycamore reveals that similar creatures were sighted in the [[Alola]] region and sends [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] to Alola to investigate.

* X removes the tent from on top of {{p|Rhyhorn|Rhyrhy}} now that his house is rebuilt.
* X reveals that he will go to [[Shalour City]] to become an official [[Mega Evolution]] Successor while Y goes to start her next semester at the Sky Trainer academy.

| class="roundybl" style="text-align:center" |''[[PS595|Magearna Moves]]''
| class="roundybr" |• Trevor discovers Magearna, an ancient artificial Pokémon, after seeing it near a vandalized museum.

• Emma is falsely accused of the museum attack, but evidence points to a second, rogue Expansion Suit.

• During a stakeout, Magearna is confronted and defends itself—Trevor protects it instead of attacking.

• Magearna is emotionally connected to a museum painting, likely of its creator.

• The rogue Expansion Suit, controlled by AI and wielding a Barbaracle, tries to steal the painting.

• Magearna defeats the suit, which is revealed to be empty and autonomous.

• Xerosic admits he built the prototype Expansion Suit to hunt Legendary Pokémon.

• The museum allows Magearna to return freely to visit the painting.

• Whitley gains the trust of Delphox, previously used by Malva.

• Trevor contacts X and Y, revealing that Sycamore and Gurkinn have left for Hoenn to study Mega Evolution.

* {{adv|Sun}} delivers {{adv|Moon}} and {{p|Rotom}} to [[Professor Kukui]].

* Professor Kukui reveals he needed a Rotom to have it [[Rotom Pokédex|combine with the Pokédex]] he gave to Sun.
* Due to Sun's mishandling of the Pokédex, Rotom refuses to enter the device.

|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM04|The Decision and the Tournament of Six]]''
|
