* Moon meets [[Lillie]].
* Lillie's {{p|Cosmog}}, [[Nebby]], runs off, forcing Moon, Lillie, and Olivia to chase after it to [[Mahalo Trail]].
* Moon discovers a strange [[Ultra Wormhole|crack in the sky]].
* Moon saves Nebby from a flock of wild {{p|Spearow}}, but Nebby causes the bridge they were standing on to be destroyed.
* Moon and Nebby are saved by {{p|Tapu Koko}}.
* After learning that Lillie was entered in the tournament as a mistake, Moon decides to take her place instead.
* The final participant in the tournament is revealed to be [[Gladion]].
* Sun starts his battle against the [[Professor Kukui|Masked Royal]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM05|The Announcement and the Prize]]''
|
* {{adv|Sun}} battles the [[Professor Kukui|Masked Royal]].
* [[Hala]] reveals the prize for winning the tournament is an [[island challenge]] amulet.
* Sun defeats the Masked Royal and advances to the next round.
* [[Gladion]] battles against [[Hau]] in the next battle.
* [[Guzma]] arrives at [[Iki Town]] and announces that he is taking {{tc|Team Skull Grunt|Grunt A}}'s place in the tournament.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM06|The Party Crasher and Guzma the Destroyer]]''
|
* [[Gladion]] defeats [[Hau]] and advances to the next round.
* {{adv|Sun}} battles against [[Guzma]] and wins, advancing him to the final round.
* {{adv|Moon}} is revealed to have obtained a {{p|Grubbin}}, a {{p|Mareanie}}, and an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Grimer}}.
* Moon and Gladion begin their battle against each other.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM07|The Final Match and a Surprising Finale!]]''
|
* {{adv|Moon}} and [[Gladion]] continue their battle.
* Moon learns about [[Regional form]]s from [[Samson Oak]].
* Gladion defeats Moon and advances to the final round.
* {{adv|Sun}} and Gladion begin their battle against each other.
* A mysterious energy shoots from the [[Ultra Wormhole|crack in the sky]] and hits the [[Sparkling Stone]] on Sun's wrist.
* The energy allows {{adv|Dollar}} to fire a [[Z-Move|powerful attack]] that defeats Gladion's {{p|Type: Null}}.
* Sun passes out from exhaustion.
* Gladion leaves and reveals that his goal is to defeat the [[Ultra Beast]]s.
* The next day, Sun awakens on a boat with the island challenge amulet, where he meets the [[Rotom Pokédex]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM08|Going Ashore and Neighboring Akala Island]]''
|
* {{adv|Moon}} receives {{p|Rowlet}} from [[Professor Kukui]].
* {{adv|Sun}} receives a task to deliver special [[Mirage Berry|Mirage Berries]] to each of [[Alola]]'s [[guardian deities]], which he accepts after learning he will be paid.
* [[Hala]] is revealed to have taken Sun's [[Sparkling Stone]] in order to fix it into [[Z-Ring|something]].
* The [[Rotom Pokédex]] is revealed to be the {{p|Rotom}} Moon transported to Alola after it combined with a spare [[Pokédex]].
* Moon takes the Rotom Pokédex for herself while Sun is given his usual Pokédex back.
* [[Gladion]] travels to the [[Ruins of Conflict]], only to find [[Guzma]] there instead of {{p|Tapu Koko}}.
* Guzma enlists Gladion as a member of [[Team Skull]] as an Enforcer.
* Sun, Moon, and Professor Kukui arrive at [[Heahea City]] on [[Akala Island]].
* Professor Kukui heads off to talk to his wife, [[Professor Burnet]].
* Sun and Moon meet [[Lana]], [[Kiawe]], and [[Mallow]], the [[Trial Captain|captains]] of Akala Island.
* Kiawe challenges Sun to a battle to see if he's worthy enough of doing the [[island challenge]].
* The battle ends without a winner, but Kiawe accepts Sun.
* Lana, still unconvinced about Sun, tells everyone to follow her to [[Brooklet Hill]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM09|True Identity and the Totem Pokémon of Brooklet Hill]]''
|
* {{adv|Sun}} is tasked by [[Lana]] to defeat the [[Totem Pokémon]] of [[Brooklet Hill]].
* Sun and Lana head off to Brooklet Hill, [[Kiawe]] goes to work, while {{adv|Moon}} and [[Mallow]] go to [[Lush Jungle]] to collect [[Berry]] samples.
* At the [[Heahea City|Dimensional Research Lab]], [[Professor Kukui]] learns from [[Professor Burnet]] that [[Nebby]] is a [[Legendary Pokémon]] named {{p|Cosmog}}.
* At Brooklet Hill, Sun befriends a wild {{p|Wishiwashi}}, which he [[nickname]]s Quarter and asks to help search for the Totem Pokémon.
* After {{adv|Dollar}} scares Quarter out of anger, it summons other Wishiwashi to form a {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Wishiwashi|School Form}} Wishiwashi, the Totem of Brooklet Hill.
* At Lush Jungle, Moon and Mallow witness {{p|Tapu Lele}} in battle with a {{p|Xurkitree}}.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM10|Defeat and the Commander of the School of Fish]]''
|
* {{adv|Moon}} tries to capture the {{p|Xurkitree}}, but it manages to escape.
* Without a name to call the [[Ultra Beast]], Moon and Mallow give it the codename "Lighting".
* {{adv|Sun}} defeats the {{pkmn2|Totem}} {{p|Wishiwashi}}.
* Sun officially adds Quarter to his team.
* [[Hala]] is visited by [[Kahili]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM11|Homecoming and the Brilliant Professional Golfer]]''
|
* [[Kahili]] reveals she was attacked by a {{p|Buzzwole}} and {{p|Kartana}} shortly after arriving in [[Alola]].
* {{adv|Moon}} is revealed to be from [[Sinnoh]] and worked under [[Mr. Berlitz]].
* With [[Mallow]]'s help, Moon finds the [[Mirage Berry]].
* Mallow receives a call from [[Kiawe]], who was attacked by someone.
* {{adv|Sun}} and [[Lana]] meet up with Moon and Mallow at [[Memorial Hill]], where they find Kiawe, lying on the ground defeated.
* A group of {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s attack, claiming that they were the ones who defeated Kiawe.
* Kiawe reveals that {{adv|Dollar}} is in possession of a [[Firium Z]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM12|The Wild Full-Power Pose of Fire]]''
|
* [[Lana]] and [[Mallow]] stay back to fight the {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s while {{adv|Sun}}, {{adv|Moon}}, and [[Kiawe]] head to the [[Ruins of Life]] to protect {{p|Tapu Lele}}.
* Kiawe teaches Sun how to perform the [[Z-Move]] {{m|Inferno Overdrive}}.
* [[Gladion]] is revealed to be Kiawe's attacker and has managed to capture {{p|Tapu Lele}}.
* Kiawe tries to lend his [[Z-Ring]] to Sun, but it is destroyed by Gladion's {{p|Type: Null}}.
* [[Kahili]] appears and delivers Sun his Z-Ring that was created by [[Hala]].
* With the Z-Ring, Sun and {{adv|Dollar}} activate Inferno Overdrive.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM13|Unleashing the Incredible Z-Move]]''
|
* {{adv|Sun}} successfully activates {{m|Inferno Overdrive}} and has {{adv|Dollar}} use it on [[Gladion]]'s {{p|Type: Null}}.
* Type: Null's mask begins to break, forcing Gladion to return it out of fear of what will happen.
* Deciding that {{p|Tapu Lele}} is too weak, Gladion retreats and tells everyone that [[Ultra Wormhole]]s exits and that something is trying to break free from them.
* After Tapu Lele awakens, Sun successfully delivers the [[Mirage Berry]] to it, completing his task.
* Tapu Lele challenges the group to a battle to test their resolve.
* Despite Tapu Lele's strength, {{adv|Dollar}} manages to land a hit on it after [[Evolution|evolving]] into a {{p|Torracat}}.
* Worried about what Gladion said, {{adv|Moon}} consults the [[Rotom Pokédex]] as [[Ultra Beast]]s could be trying to appear in Alola. The only answer it can provide is "{{p|Necrozma}}".
* At [[Aether Paradise]], [[Lusamine]] watches as a new [[Aether Foundation]] commercial is filmed.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM14|Flash and Cosmog's Secret]]''
|
* {{adv|Moon}} battles and defeats a {{pkmn2|Totem}} {{p|Lurantis}} for training.
* {{adv|Sun}} and Moon meet [[Professor Kukui]]'s wife, [[Professor Burnet]].
* Professor Burnet reveals that [[Nebby]] is capable of opening [[Ultra Wormhole]]s and may be responsible for the [[Ultra Beasts]] appearing in Alola.
* Kukui tells Burnet to take [[Lillie]] with her and meet up with him, Sun, and Moon at [[Ula'ula Island]].
* [[Lana]], [[Mallow]], and [[Kiawe]] decide to investigate [[Po Town]] to see if [[Team Skull]] knows anything about the Ultra Beasts.
* Mallow decides to call [[Ilima]] and [[Acerola]] for their assistance.
* [[Gladion]] arrives at Po Town for the first time, where he meets [[Plumeria]], a Team Skull Admin.
* A {{p|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Core}} spies on Gladion.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM15|Shipwreck and "Oh, What Sharp Teeth You Have, Bruxish!"]]''
|
* [[Professor Kukui]] takes {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} to [[Ula'ula Island]] on his yacht.
* Using [[Mantine Surf]], [[Professor Burnet]] and [[Lillie]] meet up with Kukui's group.
* A wild {{p|Bruxish}} attacks everyone, causing the group to get knocked out.
* Sun defeats Bruxish with {{p|Wishiwashi|Quarter}} and rescues Lillie, but the two end up separated from the others and end up on an Ula'ula beach.
* Acerola finds Sun and Lillie and takes them to the [[Aether House]] to recuperate.
* After Sun and Lillie properly introduce themselves to each other, Sun realizes that Acerola is a [[Trial Captain|captain]].
* Moon, Kukui, and Burnet end up rescued by the [[Aether Foundation]] and are taken to [[Aether Paradise]] to rest up.
* Moon's group is greeted by [[Faba]] and [[Wicke]], who offer to give them a tour of Aether Paradise.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM16|A Photoshoot and the Abandoned Thrifty Megamart]]''
|
* [[Faba]] and [[Wicke]] give {{adv|Moon}}, [[Professor Kukui]], and [[Professor Burnet]] a tour of [[Aether Paradise]].
* After hearing the [[Trial Captain|captains]] are going to meet with [[Team Skull]], Faba heads off to inform [[Lusamine]].
* [[Acerola]] properly introduces herself to {{adv|Sun}} and [[Lillie]].
* Acerola tells Sun that if he wants to meet with {{p|Tapu Bulu}}, he'll need to complete her [[island challenge|trial]] first.
* Sun is given the task of photographing the {{pkmn2|Totem}} Pokémon that lives inside of the abandoned {{OBP|Thrifty Megamart|Abandoned Site}} and gives him a camera to complete the task.
* After finding the Totem, a {{p|Mimikyu}}, Sun battles against it, but the camera ends up getting destroyed.
* [[Rotom Pokédex|Rotom]] reveals that it got dragged along when Sun went to rescue Lillie earlier and lets Sun use its Poké Finder function to replace the broken camera.
* At the {{al|Trainers' School}}, [[Ilima]] agrees to help [[Mallow]] and the others meet with Team Skull.
* [[Hau]] appears at the Trainers' School to meet with Ilima and is revealed to have obtained a {{p|Popplio}}.
* [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] arrive on [[Ula'ula Island]] to find someone that can help with their search for {{p|Zygarde}}'s {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cores and Cells}} scattered across Alola.
* Sun has {{adv|Dollar}} use {{m|Inferno Overdrive}} on Mimikyu to stun it long enough to take its photo, but the attack doesn't work, allowing Mimikyu to easily retaliate.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM17|A Raid and Po Town]]''
|
* [[Hau]] asks if he can join [[Ilima]] and the other [[Trial Captain|captains]] to meet with [[Team Skull]] at [[Po Town]].

* After Sun apologizes, Mimikyu joins Sun's team and is nicknamed Penny.
* [[Rotom Pokédex|Rotom]] takes a photo of Sun and Penny, successfully completing the [[island challenge|trial]].
* Realizing the [[Mirage Berry]] for {{p|Tapu Bulu}} was left behind on [[Professor Kukui]]'s yacht, Sun uses {{p|Stoutland}} [[Poké Ride|Search]] to look for another one.
* [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] spot Sun and decide to have him assist in finding the {{p|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cores and Cells}}.
* After discovering that [[Nebby]] knows about the [[guardian deities]] and Rotom can translate it, Sun decides to ask Nebby directly how to calm the deities down without the need for Mirage Berries.

* The captains and Hau arrive at Po Town, but are accosted by several {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s.
* [[Guzma]] appears and, after hearing they only want to talk, agrees to the captains' demands, but only if they're able to make it to him first.
* A {{p|Guzzlord}}, {{p|Pheromosa}}, and {{p|Celesteela}} appear to surround the captains and Hau.
* At the [[Aether House]], Sun counts his money and discovers he only needs ten million yen more to complete his goal.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM18|Confusion and Monsters from Another World]]''
|
* [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] meet with {{adv|Sun}} and ask for his help in finding the {{p|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cores and Cells}} scattered across Alola.
* Sina and Dexio offer to pay Sun one hundred thousand yen for each of the forty Cores and Cells remaining, leaving Sun with only six million yen left to save if he completes the task.
* Sun agrees to help and tells [[Lillie]] to stay behind while he goes to [[Po Town]] to begin his search.
* Sun arrives at Po Town, only to find the [[Trial Captain|captains]] and [[Hau]] easily defeated by the rampaging [[Ultra Beasts]].
* [[Guzma]] reveals he is in possession of another {{p|Cosmog}}, which he uses to open more [[Ultra Wormhole]]s to summon more Ultra Beasts.
* [[Gladion]] appears and demands that Guzma tell him where he received Cosmog from.
* On the outskirts of [[Ula'ula Island]], [[Professor Kukui]], worried about what might be happening at Po Town, drives his yacht to find a place to dock.
* {{adv|Moon}} tells Kukui to drive as close to Ula'ula as he can so she can use {{p|Rowlet}} to fly her to Po Town.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM19|Truth and the Mastermind Behind Team Skull]]''
|
* [[Gladion]] uses {{p|Type: Null}} to battle the [[Ultra Beasts]], which it does with ease as it was created by [[Aether Foundation]] specifically for that purpose.

* {{adv|Sun}} and Moon stay behind while the captains head off to rescue any people caught in the danger.
* The people of Ula'ula are evacuated to [[Hokulani Observatory]] for shelter while [[Molayne]] and [[Sophocles]] keep watch on them.
* Sophocles decides to use an invention of his to keep the Ultra Beasts away from the observatory.
* Sun collects a {{p|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cell}}.
* Moon's {{p|Grubbin}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Charjabug}}.
* Sun reveals the reason he needs to collect money is to buy back the island the Aether Foundation stole from his [[Sun's great-grandfather|great-grandfather]].
* [[Anabel]] and {{adv|Looker}}, members of the [[International Police]], arrive to question Sun and Moon.
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM20|An Urgent Task and the Capture of an Ultra Beast]]''
|
* {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} tell [[Anabel]] and {{adv|Looker}} about the [[Ultra Beast]]s in [[Alola]].
* Looker heads off to gather information about the Ultra Beasts.
* Anabel and Sun battle a {{p|Blacephalon}} that appeared from an [[Ultra Wormhole]] and try to catch it, but fail.
* {{p|Tapu Bulu}} appears and {{m|Whirlwind|blows Blacephalon away}}, rescuing everyone from it.
* Sun and Moon give Tapu Bulu the [[Mirage Berry]].
* Anabel decides to look for the person who can make [[Beast Ball|Poké Balls capable of capturing Ultra Beasts]].
|- style="background:#FFF"

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM21|Thieving and Boss Crabominable]]''
|

* {{adv|Sun}}, {{adv|Moon}}, and [[Anabel]] head to Poni Island.
* Sun goes ahead to find someone who knows where {{p|Tapu Fini}} is, only to have his [[Mirage Berry]] stolen by a pair of {{p|Crabrawler}}.
* Sun follows the Crabrawler to their [[Seafolk Village]] hideout, led by a {{p|Crabominable}}.
* After being beaten by Crabominable, Sun is rescued by [[Hapu]].

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM22|The Truth and Island Kahuna Hapu]]''
|

* Sun gives Tapu Fini a [[Mirage Berry]].

|

* Hapu reveals she is in possession of the [[Moon Flute]].
* [[Gladion]] and [[Lillie]] head to the [[Poni Altar]], but are attacked by a {{p|Xurkitree}}.

* {{adv|Moon}} and [[Anabel]] arrive to confront Faba.
* Faba has the Employees battle in his place while he tries to escape.
* [[Nebby]] and the other Cosmoem fly into the air and meet each other.

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM24|Play the Melody That Echoes in the Altar]]''
|
* {{adv|Moon}}, [[Anabel]], and [[Plumeria]] follow after [[Faba]].
* {{adv|Sun}} and [[Hapu]] are approached by a group of {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s.
* The Employees retreat when [[Gladion]] and [[Lillie]] arrive.
* The [[guardian deities]] take Sun and both flutes to the [[Poni Altar]].

| style="text-align:center" |''[[PASM27|Meeting the Ultra Recon Squad]]''

|

* [[Phyco]], the [[Ultra Recon Squad]]'s captain, arrives at the [[Poni Altar]] to take [[Lusamine]] to the [[Ultra Megalopolis]].
